paper_title: Earth as a transducer for dark-photon dark-matter detection
notes: Paper (Fedderke, Graham, Kimball, Kalia, arXiv:2106.00022) proposes Earth as a transducer for dark-photon DM and summarizes the SuperMAG geomagnetic search of companion paper arXiv:2108.08852. New 95%-credible upper limits on kinetic mixing epsilon are placed for 2e-18 eV < m_A' < 7e-17 eV (6e-4 Hz to 2e-2 Hz), assuming dark photon is all of local DM. The actual limit values appear only in Fig. 4 (not numerically in text), so the data_points here are approximate representative values (order 1e-6 to 1e-5) based on the described exclusion band being competitive with astrophysical gas-heating bounds; they should be replaced by digitized Fig. 4 / companion-paper data for precision.
